entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I bought this VeloBand Pulse and it's a complete piece of junk. It's broken and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or...?

Don't waste my time with a script! It's not working, that's the issue! The pulse tracking is all over the place and it won't sync with the app anymore. It's defective. I want a refund, not a 20-question interrogation. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, sir, and I can certainly look into this for you. I just need to pull up your order. Can I please have your name and order number?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number 774-B-91. You better fix this. I swear, I will light up your company on every review site and social media platform I can find if I don't get a refund.
Thank you, Mr. Peterson. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 27 days ago. Let me just check our return policy for you.
I don't care if it was 27 days or 27 minutes ago. The product you sold me is broken. I expect a full refund for a defective item. It's that simple.
Of course, I understand. I've just checked our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh. So you're actually going to give me a refund? No more hassle?

Yes, absolutely. Since the item is defective and you're within the allowed timeframe, I've gone ahead and authorized a full refund. I am now emailing you a prepaid shipping label to send the broken unit back to us.
Well, finally. That's what you should have done in the first place. Fine. Send me the label.
The email is on its way and should arrive in the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the device, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mr. Peterson?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
